description:
A smart digital workspace to organize web apps, accounts, and tasks in one place.

Apposition is a high-speed, local-first digital workspace designed to organize web apps, sandboxed profiles, and multitasking windows into a unified spatial canvas.
Features
- Side-by-Side Screen Splitting: Snap windows into 2, 3, or 4 side-by-side panes. Keep your storefront, analytics, and project boards visible on one screen without tab juggling.
- Separate Client Logins: Stay logged into conflicting client accounts simultaneously in dedicated workspaces without signing out or opening incognito windows.
- 1-Second Search (Cmd+K): Instant keyboard search lets you jump directly to any client tab, document, or workspace in milliseconds.
- Multi-Device Access: Use your lifetime license across 2 computers (Desktop + Laptop) with 1-click self-service license transfer in Settings.
- Tactile Restart Curtain: Smooth, instant transition curtain when applying updates with zero window freeze or sudden closures.
- Nighttime Auto-Updates: Updates apply silently in the background while your computer is idle and plugged in, ensuring you always wake up to the latest build.
